properties.name: WHAT WORKED (hxm_program, 2026-09-25, reflow2 0.69.0 → 0.70.0): `replace_text` appended a dated clarification to an enforced rule and a measurement to an accepted decision without re-sending multi-kilobyte bodies
properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (the hxm_program hub's session of 2026-09-25): "`replace_text` appended a dated clarification to an enforced rule and a measurement to an accepted decision without re-sending multi-kilobyte bodies — exactly the operation these sessions needed repeatedly." This closes the loop on the same hub's earlier reports F-08 and F-12 (2026-08-25 to 08-28): revising a Decision meant re-sending the whole field, and a wrong sentence was left in a 2 KB body with its correction elsewhere on the node. dev_storyflow reported the same value independently on 2026-09-27 (fact:field-report-dev-storyflow-2026-09-27-worked-replace-text-append-carries-a-finding-through-stages). What must not regress: append never re-sends the body, and it works on enforced rules and accepted decisions alike, under the same revision guard.
